definitions.supplemental: Cf. Goth. lustón to desire: O.H.Ger. lustón delectari, desiderare.

source_text: ge-lustian; p. ode To take pleasure in :-- Ne gelusta þú síþfatum árleásra ne delecteris semitis impiorum, Scint. 186, 5. [Cf. Goth. lustón to desire: O.H.Ger. lustón delectari, desiderare.] v. ge-lystan.
